title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Form 1099-G Calendar
content:
Two calendar figures govern the annual Form 1099-G of Unemployment Benefit Claims, identical for all seven programs (Regular State Unemployment Insurance, UCFE, UCX, Combined Wage Claim (CWC), Extended Benefits (EB), Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) and Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA)):

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Date by which the annual Form 1099-G for the prior tax year is issued | January 31 |
| Prior tax years for which a Form 1099-G correction may be requested | 3 |

For example, the Form 1099-G for a hypothetical tax year is issued by January 31 of the following year.
